title: Commemoration of 100th Anniversary of the Late Mr Lee Kuan Yew's Birth
what_it_is: Commemoration of 100th Anniversary of the Late Mr Lee Kuan Yew's Birth

sections.label: Lee Kuan Yew birth centenary
sections.summary: 16 September this year is the 100th anniversary of Mr Lee's birth, and community groups have proposed tributes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The date, 16 September this year will be the 100th anniversary of Mr Lee’s birth.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Many groups from the community – business leaders, the grassroots, academia, media, just to name a few – have come up with ideas to pay tribute to Mr Lee this year.

sections.label: Suggested tribute ideas
sections.summary: Suggested ideas include conferences, publications, youth activities, and a proposed private donation fund for educational causes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some ideas that have been suggested include conferences to examine Mr Lee’s legacies, publications drawing inspiration from Mr Lee’s values and life work, and activities to engage a new generation of Singaporeans on Mr Lee’s role in Singapore’s history.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Some business leaders have also proposed setting up a fund for private donations that will go towards supporting educational causes.

sections.label: Heritage, greening, coin activities
sections.summary: The National Heritage Board, NParks and MAS will hold exhibitions, greening activities and issue a commemorative coin.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: For example, the National Heritage Board has an ongoing travelling exhibition for the Founders’ Memorial, as part of a public call for artefacts and stories from our nation-building years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Later this year, they will have a more extensive exhibition at the National Museum on key historical milestones our founding leaders rallied our people through.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: This year also marks the 60th year of Singapore’s greening journey since Mr Lee launched the first tree planting campaign in 1963 and NParks will have various activities to mark this milestone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower and Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: MAS will also be issuing a commemorative coin later in the year, as a reminder of Mr Lee’s values and vision.
